ideas.title: Today view groups due, upcoming, and paused routines
ideas.evidence: Core flow requires a clear next action.

ideas.title: Completion history explains recent routine follow-through
ideas.evidence: Core flow requires finding a routine's history.

ideas.title: Edit routine details from the routine card
ideas.evidence: Novice browser-flow audit on 2026-08-17 found that a created routine has no correction path even though schedule editing is an explicit domain rule.

ideas.title: Expand routine cards to view the full immutable completion history
ideas.evidence: Novice core-flow audit on 2026-08-17 found that cards only expose the latest completion even though the product promises completion history and the usability loop requires users to find it.

ideas.title: Keep household routines after the local preview restarts
ideas.evidence: Core-flow audit on 2026-08-18 found that the current in-memory preview loses every user-authored routine when restarted, which breaks routine follow-through.

ideas.title: Use the household local calendar day when creating routines
ideas.evidence: Novice audit on 2026-08-18 found the creation form derives its date with UTC toISOString(), which can save the previous or next calendar day near midnight.

ideas.title: Avoid empty completion-history expansions
ideas.evidence: Novice desktop audit on 2026-08-18 created an upcoming routine and found that “Show completion history” opened an empty list despite the card already saying “No completions recorded yet.”

ideas.title: Focus Today on one household area
ideas.evidence: Novice browser audit on 2026-08-18 found that routines from different areas appear in one undifferentiated stream, so a household cannot quickly focus on the room currently being tended.

ideas.title: Make routine-card actions identify their routine
ideas.evidence: Novice browser audit on 2026-08-18 created two routines and found every card action announced only its generic verb, so assistive-technology users cannot identify the target routine from the control itself.

ideas.title: Make routine-form validation errors actionable
ideas.evidence: Novice local-browser audit on 2026-08-18 found that whitespace-only routine input reaches the server but only updates a generic status message, without marking or returning keyboard focus to the offending field.

ideas.title: Let users cancel an in-progress routine edit
ideas.evidence: Novice local-browser audit on 2026-08-18 found that opening an inline routine edit has no cancel path, forcing a user to save a change merely to collapse the form.

ideas.title: Show how many routines are in the current Today view
ideas.evidence: Novice browser audit on 2026-08-18 found that choosing an area changes the routine stream but provides no concise indication of how many routines are in the current view.

ideas.title: Keep keyboard focus oriented after routine actions refresh Today
ideas.evidence: Current-source novice audit on 2026-08-18 found successful card actions refresh and discard their original control without moving focus to the visible result.
